newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to start extraordinary Diet session Nov 29.
newsitem.headline: Japan to start extraordinary Diet session Nov 29.

text.p: Japan's ruling Liberal Democratic Party and the two parties with which it has an alliance agreed to hold an extraordinary parliament session from November 29 to December 13, a parliament source said on Wednesday.

Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto will make a policy speech on the first day, and questions from party representatives will take place between December 2 and 4 in both the Upper and Lower Houses of parliament, he said.
